lcc_original: 於是上帝造了兩個大的發光體：一個較大的發光體來管白晝，一個較小的發光體來管黑夜；又造星辰。
notes: UNV has implicit {<WH03974>} (luminary) for both the 'greater' and 'lesser' clauses, but LCC explicitly says 發光體 in all three instances — braces dropped per Rule 3
來 (purpose particle) left unannotated; Hebrew prefix ל (H9001) kept attached to 管 following UNV convention
一個 (classifier) and 較 (comparative marker) are Chinese grammatical words with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5
又造 carries no separate SN (Hebrew repeats וְאֵת but not the verb עָשָׂה); follows UNV which also leaves 又造 untagged
